d: Platinum white hair is styled in voluminous, wavy locks with a thick braid draped over the shoulder and a single long strand falling across the face. The eyes are a golden-amber hue with a calm, neutral expression, set on a youthful face with a mature demeanor. The build is slender yet curvaceous, wearing a white and navy blue outfit featuring a cleavage-baring top with gold tassels, a short white pleated skirt with blue accents, and white armored thigh guards. Visible accessories include a green bead ornament in the hair and mechanical ship components attached to the hips.
